name: VerilogEval
description: VerilogEval is a benchmark suite for evaluating large language models on digital hardware code generation tasks, specifically focusing on Verilog code completion and specification-to-RTL translation. It supports prompt engineering and failure analysis to facilitate model development.
reputation: A commonly used benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Verilog generation and RTL translation, especially in hardware-oriented code generation research.
notes: Enhancements include automatic failure classification, in-context learning support, and extension to specification-to-RTL translation tasks.
